svg.title: Layer 26: the 160 kept experts by weight share, with the mandatory tool experts
svg.desc: One bar per kept expert of layer 26, sorted by its share of the layer's routing weight on a log scale. The 17 coldest experts are all mandatory tool experts. MD drops 15 of them and 5 cold ordinary experts.
svg.text: Share of the layer's routing weight (log scale)
